```{python}
import scanpy as sc
import numpy as np
import anndata as ad
import pandas as pd
import os
import seaborn as sns
from seaborn import objects as so
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import scvi
import harmonypy as hm
```

```{python}
carpall_three = sc.read("2_carpallcohort3_doublets_identified.h5ad")
```

# ensure X layer is set up properly as sce conversion for previous doublet detection can mess with it
```{python}
carpall_three.X = carpall_three.layers["counts"].copy()
```

# identify mito, ribo and hb genes
```{python}
carpall_three.var["mt"] = carpall_three.var_names.str.startswith("MT-")
carpall_three.var["ribo"] = carpall_three.var_names.str.startswith(("RPS", "RPL"))
carpall_three.var["hb"] = carpall_three.var_names.str.contains(r"^HB[ABDEGMQZ]\d*(?!\w)")
```

```{python}
sc.pp.calculate_qc_metrics(
    carpall_three, qc_vars=["mt", "ribo", "hb"], inplace=True, percent_top=[20], log1p=True
)
carpall_three
```


```{python}
vars = ["pct_counts_mt", "pct_counts_ribo", "pct_counts_hb",
        "n_genes_by_counts", "total_counts"]

plt.close("all")

sc.pl.stacked_violin(
    carpall_three,
    var_names=vars,
    groupby="Sample_id",
    stripplot=False,
    swap_axes=True,
    yticklabels=True,
    row_palette="Set1"
)

fig = plt.gcf()

for ax in fig.axes[1:4]:
    ax.set_ylim(0, 100)
    ax.set_yticks([25, 50, 75, 100])
    ax.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=5)

ax = fig.axes[4]
ymax = ax.get_ylim()[1]
ax.set_ylim(0, ymax)
ax.set_yticks([0, 2500, 5000, 7500, 10000])
ax.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=5)

ax = fig.axes[5]
ymax = ax.get_ylim()[1]
ax.set_ylim(0, ymax)
ax.set_yticks([0, 25000, 50000, 75000, 100000])
ax.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=5)

fig.set_size_inches(6, 8)

fig.savefig(
    "./figures_cohort3/pre_qc_violins.png",
    dpi=300,
    bbox_inches="tight"
)

plt.show()
plt.close(fig)
```

```{python}
carpall_three = carpall_three[(carpall_three.obs['pct_counts_mt'] < 20) & 
    (carpall_three.obs['pct_counts_ribo'] < 50) &
    (carpall_three.obs['pct_counts_hb'] < 10) &
    (carpall_three.obs['total_counts'] > 500) & 
    (carpall_three.obs['total_counts'] < 25000) & 
    (carpall_three.obs['n_genes_by_counts'] > 300) & 
    (carpall_three.obs['n_genes_by_counts'] < 6000), :].copy()
```

```{python}
cell_counts = (
    carpall_three.obs["Sample_id"]
    .value_counts()
    .reset_index()
)

cell_counts.columns = ["Sample_id", "n_cells"]
cell_counts
cell_counts.to_csv("sample_cell_counts_post_qc.csv")
```

```{python}
pre = pd.read_csv("sample_cell_counts_pre_qc.csv")
pre = pre.rename(columns = {"n_cells": "counts_pre"})
post = pd.read_csv("sample_cell_counts_post_qc.csv")
post = post.rename(columns = {"n_cells": "counts_post"})
cell_counts = pd.merge(pre, post, how = "inner", on = "Sample_id")
cell_counts = cell_counts.drop(columns = "Unnamed: 0_x")
cell_counts = cell_counts.drop(columns = "Unnamed: 0_y")
cell_counts = pd.melt(cell_counts, id_vars=["Sample_id"], var_name="qc_stage", value_name="n_cells")
```

```{python}
plt.close("all")
plt.clf()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))

sns.barplot(
    data=cell_counts,
    x="Sample_id",
    y="n_cells",
    hue="qc_stage",
    ax=ax
)

fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig("./figures_cohort3/cell_counts_filtering.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
```

```{python}

```

```{python}
carpall_three = carpall_three[
    carpall_three.obs["doublet_class"].isin(["singlet"])
].copy()
```

```{python}
sc.pp.normalize_total(carpall_three, target_sum=1e4)
sc.pp.log1p(carpall_three)
carpall_three.layers['logcounts'] = carpall_three.X.copy()
```

```{python}
plt.figure()
sns.histplot(
        carpall_three.layers['counts'].sum(1), bins=500, kde=False
    )
plt.show()

plt.figure()
sns.histplot(
        carpall_three.layers['logcounts'].sum(1), bins=500, kde=False
    )
plt.show()
```

```{python}
sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(
    carpall_three, 
    n_top_genes=2000, 
    flavor="cell_ranger", 
    batch_key="Sample_id", 
    layer = 'logcounts',
    subset = False
)
```

# adding controversial scaling step - also allows latent variables such as percent mito to be regressed out
# in seurat scaling is standard, only in scanpy seems an issue and i lean towards including it
```{python}
carpall_three_hvg = carpall_three[:, carpall_three.var.highly_variable].copy()

sc.pp.regress_out(carpall_three_hvg, ["pct_counts_mt"])
sc.pp.scale(carpall_three_hvg)
sc.pp.pca(carpall_three_hvg)
```

```{python}
carpall_three.obsm["X_pca"] = carpall_three_hvg.obsm["X_pca"]
carpall_three.uns["pca"] = carpall_three_hvg.uns["pca"]
```

```{python}
plt.figure()
sc.pl.pca_variance_ratio(carpall_three, n_pcs=50, log=True)
plt.savefig("./figures_cohort3/Elbow_plot.png", dpi=300)
```

```{python}
sc.pp.neighbors(carpall_three, n_pcs=16, use_rep="X_pca")
sc.tl.umap(carpall_three, random_state=2026)
```

```{python}
fig = sc.pl.umap(carpall_three, color=["Patient", "Timepoint"], 
wspace=0.5,show=False, size = 2, ncols=2,frameon = False, return_fig = True)
fig.set_size_inches(14, 6)
print(fig.get_size_inches())
fig.savefig("./figures_cohort3/umap_uncorrected.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.close
```
